preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 1000, inclusive.
The lengths of strings S and A are between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: Sum of N over all test cases does not exceed 3 * 10^5
preconditions.description: The sum of the lengths of S over all test cases does not exceed 3 * 10^5.

preconditions.expression: Sum of M over all test cases does not exceed 3 * 10^5
preconditions.description: The sum of the lengths of A over all test cases does not exceed 3 * 10^5.

postconditions.expression: Output is a string S' or -1
postconditions.description: For each test case, output a string S' that does not contain A as a subsequence, or -1 if no such string exists.
